title: Chart Forge Analysis
description: Guide information extracted from an audio source by an Analyzer. Describes what happens in the music and when. This is NOT a chart: it contains no gameplay decisions, no lanes and no notes. An Editor displays this document as a guide layer for a human author. All time values are in seconds from the start of the audio unless stated otherwise. Analyzers are expected to omit any field they cannot determine; only 'version', 'audio' and 'events' are required.

version.description: Version of the Analysis document format (semantic versioning).

generator.description: Which tool produced this document, and with which settings. Provenance only; consumers must not depend on it.

tempo.description: Tempo information. 'bpm' is the overall representative tempo; 'map' describes tempo over time when it is not constant.

beats.description: Detected beat positions in ascending time order. A beat with 'isDownbeat' true starts a bar.

beatInBar.description: 1-based position of this beat within its bar.

stems.description: References to source-separated audio produced alongside this analysis. Events may point at a stem via 'source.stemId'. Audio data is never embedded here.

kind.description: Open vocabulary. Consumers must tolerate unknown values.

path.description: Path to the separated audio, relative to this document.

method.description: How the stem was produced, for provenance.

sections.description: Optional coarse structural segmentation of the track (intro, chorus, ...). Advisory only.

events.description: The musical events found in the audio. This is the primary guide layer. An event is an observation about the audio; it is not a note and carries no lane or gameplay type.

metadata.description: Free-form additional data. Not part of the contract.

timeSec.description: Time in seconds from the start of the audio.

confidence.description: How much the Analyzer trusts this value, from 0 (no confidence) to 1 (certain). Absent means unknown, which is not the same as 0.

audioRef.description: Identifies the audio this document describes. Audio is referenced, never embedded.

path.description: Path to the audio file, relative to this document unless absolute.

sha256.description: Hash of the audio file, so a consumer can detect that the audio changed.

type.description: What kind of observation this is. Open vocabulary: consumers must ignore, rather than reject, unknown types. 'onset' = a sound starts; 'note' = a pitched sound with a start and usually an end; 'percussion' = an unpitched hit; 'sustain' = a held sound; 'silence' = a gap.

endSec.description: When the event stops sounding. Absent for events with no meaningful duration, or when the Analyzer could not determine an end. Must be greater than or equal to 'startSec'.

durationSec.description: Convenience duration. When both 'endSec' and 'durationSec' are present they must agree; 'endSec' is authoritative.

source.description: Where in the mix this event came from.

stemId.description: Identifier of an entry in the top-level 'stems' array.

pitch.description: Pitch of the event, if it is pitched and the Analyzer determined it.

midi.description: MIDI note number; fractional values express detuning.

name.description: Human-readable pitch name such as C#4.

metadata.description: Analyzer-specific extra data. Consumers must not depend on any particular key.
